CLEAR BOUNDARIES

Useful checks.
No approval theatre.

Included in this beta

Core required columns and values; ID uniqueness and length; title and description length; URL syntax; availability and condition values; price syntax; sale-price comparison; GTIN length and checksum; identifier and availability-date review reminders.

What still needs a human or Merchant Center?

Shipping, tax, apparel and country-specific requirements, image quality, crawlability, landing-page matches, identifier ownership, restricted products, account suspensions, and policy compliance. A clean report is not a promise of approval.

What gets changed in a safe-fix export?

Only proposed formatting changes you choose to apply: standard column names, recognized availability/condition labels, and currency-letter capitalization. We never invent a GTIN, change an amount, remove a product, or infer stock. Review the preview and recheck your final feed.

Rules reference: Google product data specification ↗. Rule set dated 9 September 2026. CSV is an interchange format here; use the TSV export for Google's text-feed workflow.
